review:
Le Zeus casts Smokey as a counterfeit Zeus and introduced the Mystery Reveal later used in Zeus Ze Zecond. Mystery symbols land vertically on reels 2 to 5 and reveal high-paying symbols, wilds or a Mystery Reel. Wins made with revealed symbols trigger sticky respins.

Mystery Reels hold coins and diamonds as instant prizes, clovers that multiply them, and Pots of Gold that gather everything into one total. All three bonuses offer eight free spins, from Bolt & Run to the top-tier Gods Just Wanna Have Fun. The maximum is 20,000x.
